commitResults.messageBody: Update codebase branding from Duke to TaskTracker.

Implement echo command and application termination functions.

* Refactor UI interaction logic into a separate UserInterface class.
* Update UserInterface to handle welcome, message display, and exit.
* Restructure TaskTracker to act as the main application entry point.
* Add class-level and method-level documentation.

Implement storage and list displaying capabilities.

* Refactor TaskTracker.java, delegate state management via TaskTracker
UserInterface and TaskList fields.
* Create TaskList class object which stores user input into ArrayList.
* Update UserInterface to support SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE constants
and multi-line output formatting.

Prevent TaskList from growing unboundedly.

* Add MAX_TASKS constant set to 100.
* Guard task addition to reject input when capacity limit reached.
* Return user-friendly warning message on overflow attempt.

Add support for marking and unmarking stored tasks.

* Add Task class for creating and monitoring Task object status.
* Implement simple validation and error handling for TaskList index.
* Update routing logic for TaskTracker using processCommand method.

Add support for ToDo, Event, and Deadline task types.

* Add ToDo, Event, and Deadline classes inheriting from Task.
* Update routing logic in processCommand to handle
todo, deadline and event task parsing.
* Update Javadoc documentation across all classes
to match SE-EDU standards.

Create Parser and TaskTrackerException classes.

* Add Parser class to handle command argument
parsing and input validation.
* Add TaskTrackerException to handle application-specific
errors gracefully with custom error messages.
* Refactor TaskList and TaskTracker to route error
handling through TaskTrackerException.
* Update UserInterface with 'help' guide output.

Add support of deletion of tasks.

* Add deleteTask method to TaskList to remove tasks by 1-based index.
* Update Parser to include delete command syntax in error messages.
* Update TaskTracker routing logic to process delete commands.
* Update UserInterface help guide to display delete command usage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add draft of Storage class for file persistence

commitResults.messageBody:
Implement Storage class to handle reading and writing tasks to disk.

* Save task list automatically on any data update
* Parse stored text data back into Task objects on app startup
* Handle missing save files and directory creation automatically

Implement Message class to separate UI logic from business logic.

* Centralize UI strings, banners, and error templates in Message class.
* Decouple task execution and parsing from user interface rendering.
Add JavaDoc comments to all classes.

Add date and time support in a standard format.

* Introduce TaskDateTime wrapper class to parse and display dates.
* Input in 'uuuu-MM-dd HHmm' format using strict validation.
* Display dates in human-readable 'MMM d yyyy, h:mm a' format.
